experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Public text corpus, bag-of-words model, CPU only.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether bigram features improve sentiment classification accuracy over unigrams alone.
experiment_plans.design: Ablation: identical classifier, unigram features vs unigram+bigram features.

data_requirements.description: A labelled English movie-review sentiment corpus with a text field and a binary label field.
preprocessing_steps: Load the review text and labels

methods.name: naive bayes
methods.description: Multinomial naive Bayes with Laplace smoothing over token counts.

evaluation.baseline: Unigram naive Bayes on the same split.
evaluation.success_criteria: Adding bigrams improves accuracy by at least 0.02 on the held-out split.

risks: Bigram vocabulary may be too sparse on a small sample.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
